toml-values.toml:
schema_version = 1
output = "client"
package = "client"
model_package = "models"
transport = "httpx2"
default_base_url = "https://api.example.com"
server_base_url = "https://api.example.com/base/"
signature_style = "unpack"

[[resource_names]]
tag = "pets"
namespace = "animals"

[[operations]]
ref = "/paths/~1pets/get"
resource = "animals"
name = "list_pets"
request_media_type = "application/json"
response_media_type = "application/json"
description = "List them."
parameter_names = [{ in = "query", name = "limit", python_name = "page_size" }]
runtime = { request_id_header = "X-Request-Id", success_statuses = [302] }

[[operations]]
ref = { pointer = "/paths/~1pets/post" }

toml-invalid-location.toml:
schema_version = 1

parameter_names = [{ in = "body", name = "limit", python_name = "limit" }]

toml-invalid-statuses.toml:
schema_version = 1

[[operations]]

runtime = { success_statuses = ["302"] }
